description: Omitted subject after context about a third person (host family talking about their son Kenji) must keep Kenji as subject, not the speaker. Sentence-final particles/hedges (〜わ, たぶん) must not be read as first-person evidence.

contextMessages.text: 健二は今日、部活の後に友達と出かけるみたい。

text: 多分カラオケに行くと思うわ。
